parsed.note_claim: Instagram does not notify users of screenshots in regular DM chats; notifications only occur for disappearing photos/videos or Vanish Mode.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Screenshots of other types of non-disappearing content that have been sent in direct messages (such as posts from feeds, text, or hashtags) won't result in a notification.
parsed.reason: The article confirms that non-disappearing direct messages do not trigger notifications, while disappearing photos or videos do.
